name: Vela
rationale: Vela is Latin for sail, so the mark is one sail cut by the line of an orbit. An uppercase Archivo wordmark with an open A, like a nose cone, puts it with the hardware and space leaders.

colors.idea: Ignition Orange #FF4F1A: the color of a burn at lift off, warm against the white and blue of most space brands.

symbol.idea: A sail cut by the line of an orbit.

wordmark.idea: Archivo 800 in capitals, with the A drawn open like a nose cone.

alternatives.label: Option 2: Cut disc
alternatives.why: A planet with a V taken out of it, heavy enough to hold at 16 px, in a bright beacon amber.

alternatives.label: Option 3: Trajectory
alternatives.why: The arc a rocket draws after lift off, ending in its payload, in a deep cobalt.

alternatives.label: Option 4: Horizon
alternatives.why: A rocket rising off the curve of the earth, simple and literal, for a company that wants to read instantly.
